name: Rent-Free
tagline: You love like it's a getaway. Even where you stop is a hideout.
epigraph: Its wine spends a night in the cold, as two newlyweds kept theirs: in a mine.
glassware: a tall stemmed wine glass, filled with ice
language_row: Wren's resonance: ready (v2; carried to v3 in r5). Guest text and closing line 4-gram clean against every pour (Wren r3–r5). Gendered pronouns refer to Robert Louis Stevenson only; the reading never needs the guest to have a partner ("whoever or whatever you chose"). History about 48% of yours.

names_note: Rent-Free (Tomás, Wren; Hester once y2 carried it in his own quoted words, as what tempted him). Also considered: Stopped Here (Hester's, withdrawn), Picked the Place, Home Ground.
open_items: Balance: wine only, by the room's choice (Wren: "the band, never the brandy"). Strength 9.4% is an EDGE under the highball floor of 10%, which is built from the Whisky Highball; sugar and acid in band. A 15 ml brandy version was proved in range and struck: it adds a spirit beside the wine the story chose.

The wine is a style, not a bottle: a crisp, dry, unoaked California white; Stevenson tasted one sold as "Hock" in a Napa cellar. Its values in the new row are unsourced. The bay leaf is plain bay, never "his bay": the page says only "sweet bay" (probably California bay laurel, unsourced). Just Knew also uses bay; owned (no jar, no bay in the closing line).

Kept out: why they went up the mountain or to Samoa (his health, and their money), his illness and death, "steerage" (he went second cabin; sentence cut), the Gosse letter and Sanchez ch. IV's 1876 dating (inside her first marriage), the Kelmar chapter (antisemitic), "bottled poetry" (his hope for undiscovered vineyards), Byron (medicine), "fourteen rich years" (dossier only: points to an end date). Cicero's epigraph is dossier only, because Cicero's next sentence weighs the other way.

Rent-free is the idea that tempted him ("rent-free, into a ready-made house"), first said with his eye on Pine Flat; the reading never says they paid no rent. Vailima: "home" is Nellie's word, Fanny's sister, a loving witness.
